item.title: Seetel tops NT$8.2B in first seven months amid US and Australia expansion
item.summary: Seetel reported strong momentum in 2026 as large-scale energy storage projects and battery module shipments lifted revenue, while the Taiwan-based energy systems company moved to broaden its footprint in the US and Australia. The firm said its first seven months of revenue reached nearly NT$8.2 billion (US$254.4 million), supported by demand tied to AI data centers, virtual power plants and energy infrastructure.
